description: Defines the argument evaluation procedures for SARG. Evaluation determines whether a constructed argument satisfies all four SARG invariants, passes structural soundness checks, achieves warrant coverage across all claim-evidence pairs, and is free from prohibited reflexive loops. Evaluation is a sequential gate process — each gate must pass before the next executes.

evaluation_model.determinism_guarantee: INV-TEL-002 applies — the TEL encoding of A has exactly one structural interpretation. Evaluation results are deterministic given the same A and C_A.
evaluation_model.session_binding: Evaluation results are session-scoped. A re-submitted argument with modified N_A or R_A is treated as a new argument A' and evaluated independently.
evaluation_model.upstream_prerequisite: TEL-Σ must have returned PASS on the TEL encoding of A before SARG evaluation begins

evaluation_gates.label: Integrity Gate
evaluation_gates.description: Verify that every node in N_A is reachable from root(A) via declared relations in R_A. Compute reach(A) by directed traversal from root(A). Nodes not in reach(A) are classified as orphans.
procedure: Initialize reach = {root(A)}
Traverse R_A: for each r ∈ R_A, if r.target ∈ reach, add r.source to reach
Repeat until reach stabilizes
orphan_set = N_A \ reach(A)
If orphan_set ≠ ∅: record all orphans; they are excluded from evaluation
If reach(A) = {root(A)} only: argument has no supporting structure — flag as EG-001 minimal violation
evaluation_gates.pass_condition: reach(A) computed and recorded; orphan_set recorded (may be empty)
evaluation_gates.fail_condition: Traversal error (malformed R_A); reach(A) cannot be computed

gate_outcome.fail: Halt; R_A structure error must be corrected before re-evaluation

evaluation_gates.notes: Orphan presence does not fail EG-001 — orphans are excluded from evaluation, not an error condition. The gate fails only if reach(A) itself cannot be computed.

evaluation_gates.label: Warrant Coverage Gate
evaluation_gates.description: For every claim-evidence pair in reach(A), verify that at least one declared Warrant node in warrants(A) bridges the evidence node to the claim node. Uncovered pairs are INV-SARG-002 violations.
procedure: Enumerate all CE_pairs(A): pairs (c, e) where c ∈ reach(A) is a Claim node and e ∈ reach(A) is an Evidence node with a relation path e → c
For each (c, e) ∈ CE_pairs(A): check whether ∃w ∈ warrants(reach(A)): w.source = e ∧ w.target = c
Uncovered pairs: CE_pairs where no such w exists
Record uncovered_pairs list
If uncovered_pairs ≠ ∅: record INV-SARG-002 violations for each uncovered pair
evaluation_gates.pass_condition: uncovered_pairs = ∅ (all CE pairs have at least one declared Warrant bridge)
evaluation_gates.fail_condition: uncovered_pairs ≠ ∅ — at least one CE pair lacks warrant coverage

gate_outcome.fail: Argument is invalid at INV-SARG-002. Record all uncovered pairs. Argument construction must add Warrant nodes for uncovered pairs before re-evaluation.
gate_outcome.partial_suspension: If some but not all CE pairs are covered: argument is partially valid — the covered paths may be reported while the uncovered paths are suspended

evaluation_gates.label: Defeat Completeness Gate
evaluation_gates.description: Review all registered defeat attempts against A. Verify that each defeat that claims structural completeness has a recorded structural target in (nodes(A) ∪ R_A ∪ C_A). Reclassify incomplete defeats as parallel assertions.
procedure: Retrieve all defeat records D_1 ... D_k registered against A in the session defeat log
For each D_i: check that D_i.T_D ∈ (reach(A) ∪ R_A ∪ C_A)
For each D_i: confirm that O_D(T_D) produces at least one structural change (DCV-2 check)
Incomplete D_i: reclassify as PA[parallel_assertion] — no effect on A's validity
Complete D_i: apply O_D to A; recompute reach(A); re-run EG-001 and EG-002 on modified A
Record final defeat tally: complete_defeats, reclassified_assertions
evaluation_gates.pass_condition: All registered defeats are either classified complete (with recorded structural effect) or reclassified as parallel assertions. No defeat records are in ambiguous state.
evaluation_gates.fail_condition: A defeat record exists with an ambiguous or unresolvable target — neither confirmable as structural nor dismissible as surface

gate_outcome.fail: Session fault — defeat record must be resolved before proceeding
gate_outcome.notes: A completely defeated argument (all paths to root(A) severed) returns eval_SARG = invalid here; no further gates needed

evaluation_gates.label: Reflexive Prohibition Gate
evaluation_gates.description: Detect all paths in reach(A) that return to root(A). For each closed path, verify that at least one node on the path satisfies independent_evidence(n_i, root(A)). Paths that return to root(A) with no independent evidentiary node are prohibited reflexive loops.
procedure: Enumerate all cycles in the directed graph of reach(A)
For each cycle C_j that includes root(A):
— Extract all nodes n_i ∈ C_j
— For each n_i: evaluate independent_evidence(n_i, root(A)) ⟺ provenance(n_i) ∩ derivation_closure(root(A)) = ∅
— If ∀n_i ∈ C_j: ¬independent_evidence(n_i, root(A)): C_j is a prohibited reflexive loop
If any prohibited loops exist: record them; argument is invalid at INV-SARG-004
If all cycles through root(A) contain at least one independent evidentiary node: gate passes
evaluation_gates.pass_condition: No prohibited reflexive loops found in reach(A), OR all cycles through root(A) contain at least one independent evidentiary node
evaluation_gates.fail_condition: At least one cycle through root(A) contains no independent evidentiary node

gate_outcome.fail: Argument is invalid at INV-SARG-004. Record prohibited loop(s). Argument must be restructured — either the circular path must be broken, or an independent evidentiary node must be inserted on the path.

independence_check.definition: n_i is independent of root(A) if: provenance(n_i) ∩ derivation_closure(root(A)) = ∅
independence_check.derivation_closure: The set of all nodes that can be derived from or are logically contained within root(A)'s content. Restatements, elaborations, and direct consequences of root(A) are in its derivation closure.
independence_check.note: This is a structural check, not a semantic one. SARG does not evaluate propositional truth — it evaluates structural provenance. An evidence node is structurally independent if it was constructed and declared independently of root(A).

evaluation_gates.label: Constraint Satisfaction Gate
evaluation_gates.description: Evaluate the argument A against all declared constraints in C_A. C_A may include domain-specific constraints, GRL legitimacy requirements (from Book 6), TEL-encoded invariant assertions, and SARG session constraints. All constraints must be satisfied for eval_SARG = valid.
procedure: Retrieve C_A from the argument definition
For each c_i ∈ C_A: evaluate whether reach(A) (post-defeat, post-orphan-exclusion) satisfies c_i
Unsatisfied constraints: record as constraint_violations list
If constraint_violations = ∅ and all four EG gates passed: eval_SARG = valid
If constraint_violations ≠ ∅: eval_SARG = invalid; record all violations
evaluation_gates.pass_condition: constraint_violations = ∅ and EG-001 through EG-004 all passed
evaluation_gates.fail_condition: Any constraint in C_A is unsatisfied

gate_outcome.valid: eval_SARG = valid; proceed to catalogue phase for SARG-Σ output
gate_outcome.invalid: eval_SARG = invalid; record violation log; argument may be revised and re-submitted
gate_outcome.suspended: One or more constraints are in partial defeat suspension — evaluation is pending resolution of the defeat record

soundness_model.description: SARG soundness is distinct from logical soundness. A SARG-sound argument satisfies all structural constraints; it does not guarantee that its propositional conclusions are true.
soundness_model.sarg_soundness_definition: sound_SARG(A) ⟺ eval_SARG(A) = valid ∧ ∀c ∈ C_A: A ⊨ c
soundness_model.distinction: An argument can be SARG-sound and propositionally false. An argument can be propositionally true and SARG-invalid. These properties are orthogonal. SARG evaluates structure; propositional truth is outside its scope.
soundness_model.practical_implication: Downstream consumers of SARG evaluation results (Book 8 NoS, Book 9 PD) receive structural validity reports, not truth assessments. Interpreting a SARG-valid argument as propositionally true is an INV-TEL-002 violation — it reads more into the evaluation result than the result encodes.

evaluation_failure_modes.label: Premature Validity Claim
evaluation_failure_modes.description: Claiming eval_SARG = valid before all five evaluation gates have completed
evaluation_failure_modes.detection: EG completion log is missing one or more gate records
evaluation_failure_modes.resolution: Complete all gates; do not report validity until EG-005 completes

evaluation_failure_modes.label: Orphan Inclusion
evaluation_failure_modes.description: Including orphan nodes in the evaluation after EG-001 excluded them
evaluation_failure_modes.detection: A node in the warrant coverage check (EG-002) is in the orphan_set
evaluation_failure_modes.resolution: Re-run EG-002 using reach(A), not N_A

evaluation_failure_modes.label: Defeat Inversion
evaluation_failure_modes.description: Using a defeat record that was reclassified as a parallel assertion to modify A's validity status
evaluation_failure_modes.detection: A PA[...] record appears in the defeat tally as complete
evaluation_failure_modes.resolution: Separate complete_defeats from reclassified_assertions in the tally; only complete_defeats affect A

evaluation_failure_modes.label: Reflexivity Bypass
evaluation_failure_modes.description: Skipping EG-004 because no obvious cycle is visible — failure to detect non-obvious cycles in deeply nested argument graphs
evaluation_failure_modes.detection: Cycle enumeration was not performed (EG-004 record missing)
evaluation_failure_modes.resolution: Run full cycle enumeration on the directed graph of reach(A) regardless of apparent acyclicity

evaluation_failure_modes.label: GRL Feed Ignored
evaluation_failure_modes.description: Evaluating a governance-domain argument without loading the regime_status_report from GRL-Σ as a potential evidence source, leading to uncovered CE pairs that could have been covered by legitimacy evidence
evaluation_failure_modes.detection: Book 6 GRL was a declared dependency but regime_status_report was not queried
evaluation_failure_modes.resolution: In init phase, confirm GRL regime_status_report is available and load it as structured evidence before argument construction begins

table.check: CE pair warrant coverage; uncovered_pairs detection
